notes.title: Patch Notes: Hotfix 1 - 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Balance adjustments
Reduced frequency of orbital laser

Slightly reduced the competitiveness of the AI in quick race, ranked race & private race

This is an ongoing journey, so we're looking for additional feedback from the community to see if they enjoy the difficulty as it is now, or if we should scale it back further.



Bug fixes/other adjustments:
Improved performance on PS5 Pro

XSX crash on boot should now be resolved

We have had trouble reproducing this on our side, so this fix is exploratory.

If you are a community member that's still facing this issue after this update, please let us know

Resolved issue that caused Steam Achievements to not be functional

Resolved rare instances where a reward was not received after finishing a grand circuit

Players who already finished a grand circuit, but didn't receive the reward, should now receive it when starting the game

Set crossplay to ON by default for platforms that support this functionality

Updated splashscreens

notes.title: Launch Day Patch Notes - 1.0.0.0
notes.notes:
MAJOR UPDATE NOTES

Update 4 - 1.0.0.0
Single PlayerNew Game Mode: Championship
New single-player game mode: Grand Circuit.

Race against AI in 5 different cups of varying difficulties.

Cups include 3 races across 3 different stages, you’ll need to have the highest total score across all races to win!

Earn exclusive cup rewards by finishing first in the cups

After winning all cups in Grand Circuit you unlock Grand Circuit: Expert Mode which will challenge and reward you further.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/fd980b2cc987d51b4d8a6e81f2f749fd4f6489a3.png"]




Vehicle CustomizationNew Feature: Color Customization
All vehicles can now have their livery color customized, divided over 4 categories; Primary color, Secondary color, Detailing color, and Emissive color. 

The color categories can be adjusted in the last tab (color) in the garage.

The Primary color category targets the largest livery surface.

The Secondary color category targets the second largest livery surface.

The Detailing color category can be used to adjust the color of details.

The Emissive color can be used to adjust the color of the emissive elements on the vehicle body and the front lights.

Every vehicle also has 6 preset color combinations to choose from as a starting point. From there the player can adjust the individual color categories as they please.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/6739559e4e9b70ecb5e29b49778c6747f426f6ca.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/31df544b8eff7d9bbfef672efccde31cd81d21a2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/28de05302f5a2e04610fbefbb38e807ff9db2d33.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/82fdbd4439f5b927bdfdb17c8d3c5cf1cde6c88b.jpg"]
VehiclesNew Vehicle: Fury
A new light weight vehicle has been added, the Fury!

Basic Ability: Lightpulse Rounds, fires a flurry of energy rounds dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Repel Mine, deploys a mine behind the vehicle that damages and launches any vehicle that drives over it.

The Fury can be unlocked by completing the ‘Darkwave Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit’ championship.

The Fury has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/7c1557df96933d5fb4322f029d1ca645e2b09604.jpg"]
New Vehicle: Angry Panda
A new light weight vehicle has been added, the Angry Panda!

Basic Ability: Ion Rays, a burst of ion beams dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Scorch Barrier, deploys a barrier behind the vehicle that sets any vehicle passing through on fire, dealing damage over time.

The Angry Panda can be unlocked by completing the ‘Darkwave Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit: Expert’ championship.

The Angry Panda has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/b573f69e128f851af10b2df71452792046c8e723.jpg"]
New Vehicle: Echo
A new medium weight vehicle has been added, the Echo!

Basic Ability: Plasma Grenade, a volley of plasma grenades dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Seeker Rocket, a targetable rocket that deals massive area damage on impact.

The Echo can be unlocked by completing the ‘Vortex Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit’ championship.

The Echo has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/ab5574f76feeef5f6aaff6695c3af72baec78a82.jpg"]New Vehicle: Apollo
A new medium weight vehicle has been added, the Apollo!

Basic Ability: Pyro Rounds, a burst of incendiary rounds dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Cyber Tail, leaves a continuous wall of energy behind the vehicle while activated, slowing and damaging any vehicle that drives through it.

The Apollo can be unlocked by completing the ‘Vortex Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit: Expert’ championship.

The Apollo has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/6a6fa0f82a615c63789a2e05986e21fbde839888.jpg"]
New Vehicle: Hellion
A new heavy weight vehicle has been added, the Hellion!

Basic Ability: Infernal Strike, a burst of heavy laser blasts dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Stinger, a targetable projectile that deals damage to targets and disables ability usage for a time.

The Hellion can be unlocked by completing the ‘Solar Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit’ championship.

The Hellion has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/6dd64f2bd15d9205de84fd421b4762a4ea2d35c5.jpg"]
New Vehicle: Beast
A new heavy weight vehicle has been added, the Beast!

Basic Ability: Infernal Strike, a burst of heavy laser blasts dealing damage to targets.

Special Ability: Nitro Leap, it launches the Beast forwards into the air, forcing all surrounding vehicles away when landing.

The Beast can be unlocked by completing the ‘Solar Cup’ in the ‘Grand Circuit: Expert’ championship.

The Beast has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/14af2d2ec05d808ca69b953541f67fdeea395b8f.jpg"]
TracksNew Track: Neon Nihon Bay & Neon Nihon Bay Reverse
A new track has been added to the roster! Neon Nihon Bay and its reversed counterpart. Race your way through the wide highways along the shore and tight city streets to the massive temple crowning this metropole. 

Master your drifting on this winding track featuring a number of long corners.

Survive and overcome the combat chaos in the tight city streets.

Pick your best route in a series of small traversal choices.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/c576afc9b4a4655fbc32f28b016901f3ffcee146.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/e23b9a35e360bd92f90902291de183c3734412eb.png"]
Track General improvements
Several tracks have received adjustments to corners for a smoother cornering experience.

Track height limits have been increased to prevent being destroyed during a particularly high jump (looking at you Mad Rabbit).

Twister Reverse improvements

Increased width of the track in choke points to create a less tense racing experience.

Added boostpads at widened areas to keep the sense of speed.

Removed tight jumps to prevent players from either crashing into the barrier at jumps or jumping off the track.

Moved the location of pickups to more balanced locations.

Pipes improvements 

Improved the general atmosphere of the level with lighting and fog and material changes.

Improved the environment within the pipes to create a better immersive experience.

Improved smoothness of the downward slope to prevent cars smashing into the track and receiving unwanted air time.

Saltspine Reverse improvements 

Improved several jump landings to prevent cars smashing onto the track.

Reduced difficulty of a barrierless tight turn, which now is wider and more accident proof.

Added more signposting to improve player navigation.

Cyber Arena improvements 

Improved several jumps and landings to prevent cars from smashing into the track or jumping off the track.

Improved the environment around the track to create a better immersive experience.

Moved the location of pickups to more balanced locations.

Added more healthpads to increase player survivability.
CombatNew Ability pickup: Orbital Laser
A new ability has been added to the ability pickups, the Orbital Laser. A huge laser from the sky targets the leading vehicle for a moment before unleashing its massive damage and slow. It is another tool in the arsenal for vehicles that are particularly far ahead of the rest.

Every vehicle except the lead has a small chance to receive an orbital laser from an ability pickup once in a while. Depending on the position of the player picking it up and the distance to the leading vehicle the chance can be higher. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/e0dfceb854cc306dfd54d9835c10234954692096.png"]


Kill Marker
Killing an opponent vehicle will now give the instigator player a ‘kill marker’, giving clear and satisfying feedback on your triumph.

The kill marker is separate from your hitmarker, ensuring you still get the hit information from your hitmarker.

The name of the opponent a player killed is still displayed in the kill feed at the top right of the screen.

The kill marker stacks, counting up if a player gets consecutive kills while the kill marker is still active.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023879/b277a08e887215262c812893ce3d1147d3cf1bad.png"]
Kill Attribution
Self-destruct and fall-of-track deaths will now be attributed as kills to the player that within the last five seconds hit the vehicle last. Rewarding players for knocking vehicles off-track and preventing kill avoidance by self-destructing.
Combat balancing improvements
Summary

Pickup Ability balance changes

Rebalanced pick-up probability per position

Increased general survivability;

Slightly reduced basic ability damage.

Reduced the high ends of special ability and pickup ability damage.

Increased armor gain from armor pickups (10 > 20)

Reduced armor pickups respawn time (5s > 3s)

Made death more punishing;

(Re)spawn armor reduced (50 > 40)

Respawn vehicle velocity reduced by 33%

Armor damage is now counted towards the end of race statistics ‘damage taken’ and ‘damage done’, as well as achievements.

The ‘Deaths Head’ special ability now no longer can be targeted, but instead is a dumb-fire projectile. The effectiveness of the ability was too great for the ease of use.

Severely increased projectile size.

Added additional VFX to better portray the time between attaching to a vehicle until exploding.
Miscellaneous
Added Steam Cloud Save support

Improved grinding collision behavior between the vehicles and the barriers of the track

The game will now wait longer for all players to load into an Online race before starting it

Fixed incorrect keyboard mappings being showcased during the Tutorial level

Fixed incorrect keyboard mappings being showcased in the HUD

Fixed Online track vote count persisting after the player leaves the Online Race Lobby

Adjusted Wheel and Mod part prices

Vehicle collision is disabled upon death which allows players behind them to drive straight through

Fixed Saltspine Crushers not killing the players in Online races

Improved end of Online race timer logic

Various leaderboard improvements

With this patch the leaderboards in-game will reset

Added new splash screens and updated credits

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3.0 is available now
notes.notes:
Hey Clutchers,

We’re excited to bring you new patch update that includes combat overhaul, 2 new vehicles, the track improvements & more!

Here are the details of what’s new:

[previewyoutube=GG38UnnGfbY;full][/previewyoutube]

Combat Overhaul
Vehicle Armor
Energy and the Shield Ability has been replaced for Vehicle Armor to reduce active focus on defense, increase survivability, and allow players to focus more on offense and racing.

 Incoming Abilities first damage and deplete Armor before hitting the player’s health pool
 Drive over Armor Pickups to replenish some Armor


Ability Pickups
Ability Pickups give a semi-random Ability depending on the player’s race position. These abilities can help the player catch up or overtake, defend or attack.

 Drive over an Ability Pickup to receive an ability in the [Right Face Button] slot
 The Ability will remain in the slot until use. The slot needs to be empty before a new Ability can be picked up
 Depending on the player’s race position they have a higher chance of receiving certain abilities


Ability Targeting
Only Special Abilities can now be targeted and require a Lock-On to home to their target. Basic Abilities are now shot using dumb-fire only. This has introduced more skill expression and player agency in offense.

 Targeting is now only for projectile Special Abilities [Up Face Button]. When a projectile Special Ability is available and off cooldown and a target is within range, targeting will automatically activate
 A Lock-On is established when having an opponent targeted for 1 second. Projectile Special Abilities shot during a Lock-On will automatically home towards the target. Shooting before a Lock-On will dumb-fire the projectile
 Dumb-firing shoots projectiles forward from the player’s vehicle. The projectiles will follow the vertical curvature of the road, going up and down slopes. This requires players to aim for targets using their vehicle
 Basic Abilities [Left Face Button] are now dumb-fire only


Hit Boost
Hitting an opponent with Abilities now gives the owner of those Abilities a small speed boost, rewarding the player for the hit and giving the opportunity to catch up, overtake or stay ahead.

Speed Boosts
Speed Boosts now scale their intensity and duration depending on the player’s racing position, allowing players that are behind an opportunity to catch up. New speed boost sources have also been added.

 Speed Boosts now scale their intensity and duration depending on the player’s racing position
 For Example: In first place a player’s speed boost might be active 1 second where in last it might be active 2.5 seconds
 Ability Pickups have multiple Abilities in their pool that provide a speed boost to the player

Opponents Status Displays
Status Displays are now displayed above every opponent. Allowing players to make more informed combat decisions and providing hit feedback.

 The Status Display shows vital information like the opponents Health (green bar), Armor (blue bar), and whether the opponent has a shield active (bars become white)
 Received damage is indicated in the Health & Armor Bars with orange nodes
 The Status Displays are visible within a certain distance of a player and when receiving damage


Ability Balancing
General balancing changes have been applied to Abilities to improve competitiveness and the value of each Ability.

 Projectiles can now destroy Ability Barriers & Mines. Mines will still explode on destruction
 Basic Ability cooldowns have been lowered and damage has been increased across the board
 Special Abilities cooldowns have been increased and base damages have been slightly increased
 Barrier and Mine abilities lifetimes have been reduced
 Null Barrier & Null Rounds no longer reduce Energy, instead now do additional damage to Armor
 Flame Wake DOT now applies only once, stacking damage (until a cap) and resetting its duration for each instance of the Flame Wake hit. Dealing low damage when briefly driving through the Flame Wake but rapidly building damage when staying within
 Sonic Boom no longer instantly activates but now has a brief windup, giving an opportunity to players with a shield and a fast reaction time to block

Vehicles
New Vehicle: Acid
A new Light Vehicle has been added to the game, the Acid. The neon-colored punk racer is ready to burn it all down.

 Basic Ability: Photon Cascade. Fires a burst of 6 projectiles
 Special Ability: Flame Wake. Leaves a trail of flames behind the vehicle
 The Acid can be unlocked in the Garage for 1000 Credits
 The Acid has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage


New Vehicle: Ramgrith
A new Medium Vehicle has been added to the game, the Ramgrith. The tough no-nonsense vehicle sporting a grenade launcher will blow its way through the competition.

 Basic Ability: Plasma Grenades. Fires a burst of 5 projectiles
 Special Ability: Deaths Head. A projectile which will launch any target it sticks to after a short delay
 The Ramgrith can be unlocked in the Garage for 1000 Credits
 The Ramgrith has two sets of aesthetic parts to unlock in the Garage

Tracks
General Map Changes
Energy cell rebalancing and addition of ability pickups.

 Energy cell placement was rebalanced to fit the new shield system
 New ability pickups were added to all levels

Track - Rooftop Run & Rooftop Run Reverse
Harsh corners were adjusted, jumps made more forgiving, jumps upwards changed to a large ramp.

 The hard corner at the start of the level was made easier by cutting off a part of the building
 Steep road upwards with jumps that would often result in cars falling off the track was transformed into a double road that allows lane switching
 The jumps from rooftop to rooftop were made more forgiving with added balconies.
 General fixes related to faulty collision, art, & gameplay
 Added barriers to prevent cars getting stuck at inopportune moments

Track - Saltspine & Saltspine Reverse
Roads changed for better drifting, upper deck removed in the large corner of reverse.

 Reworked some of the turns to allow for better drifting
 Road was smoothed out as there were issues with the angle causing bumps to form
 Upper deck of the big turn in reverse was removed as it caused issues with cars launching themselves off the track

Track - The Strand & The Strand Reverse
Alternate road changed to merge with the main road sooner, roads changed for a better drifting experience

 The alternate thin drift path was changed to merge with the main road sooner than it was before, the curve of the angle allows for better drifting
 The main road turn next to the beach was rounded out for better drifting

Track - Twister & Twister Reverse
The large thin drifting corner was changed to be more consistent.

 Changed the angle of the large thin turn to make it easier to drift along while keeping some challenge in doing so. Adjusted the road following the turn to facilitate this change

Miscellaneous

 Fixed various Achievements not unlocking correctly. All Achievements now should be reachable
 Adjusted Scythe & Wasp vehicle handling to be more in line of how other vehicles handle
 The tutorial has been updated to inform players about the most important new features
 The HUD speedometer changes in color and slightly scales up depending on the vehicle’s speed
 The HUD Health & Armor bars become white when shielded
 The HUD ability icons become gray when the player’s abilities have been disabled by the Stinger ability
 The hitmarker now indicates when the player hit a shield with their ability
 Several ability icons have been simplified for better communication
 Ability icons indicate whether a projectile ability is targetable with a border
 AI opponents now generally use their abilities more effectively



We would love to hear your thoughts on the new changes & improvements! Please use our Community Discord to share your feedback and suggestions.

Happy racing,
The Cyber Clutch Team

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2.0 is available now
notes.notes:
Hey Clutchers,

We’re excited to bring you new patch update that includes improvements to the driving experience, combat, the tracks & more!

Here are the details of what’s new:

Driving Experience

 Auto correction no longer swings the vehicle
 Increased vehicle grip
 Changed steering angles on higher speeds
 Adjusted the speed value of drift boost levels
 Speed boosts now override maximum speed
 Camera screen effects now blend with acceleration, instead of static boost effects
 Changed oscillation of car speed camera shake to prevent nausea
 Camera rotation now starts following the car when the car reaches certain steering input to give less static feeling to the camera behavior
 Introduced more slight differences of vehicles within the weight classes to make the vehicles feel more unique
 Fixed cars climbing on walls
 Fixed cars climbing on other cars
 Player starts with higher initial speed after respawning

Combat
Combat changes
Introduced ‘lock-on’ mechanic, to require proper racing in effective attacking

 Players are required to target opponents for 1 second before any fired projectiles will home in on opponents
 The reticle changes color when the time requirement has been reached
 Losing the target will reset the locking in mechanic
 Players can still fire projectile abilities before the time requirement has been reached, projectiles will then travel in a straight line

All offensive abilities no longer require energy but still go on cooldown after use

 Energy is now only used by the Shield ability, which enables the player to participate in both offense and defense simultaneously. One full energy bar allows two shield usage
 Introduced short cooldown between shield activation, to give offensive players a gap in defense to exploit
 Default key binds are now more intuitive: X for Basic Attack and B for Shield

Offensive Balancing
Basic Abilities

 Reduced cooldown of Basic Attack abilities with slight differences between per class
 Slightly reduced damage of Basic Attack abilities
 Increased fire rate of all Basic Attacks & all Basic Attacks now deliver their full damage faster

Special Abilities

 Increased damage of most Hazard Special abilities (Mines, Barriers)
 Reduced lifetime of Hazard Special abilities (Mines, etc.)
 Increased Cooldown of Hazard Special abilities (Mines, etc.)

Ability Activation

 When the race starts offensive abilities will have a default cooldown of 8 seconds before they can be used. 
This allows the pack to settle in its initial configuration before combat is enabled with an explosive start
 When a vehicle respawns, its offensive abilities will have a default cooldown of 8 seconds before they can be used.
 This allows previous attackers to overtake in relative safety, preventing being immediately shot down by respawned vehicles.

User Interface
HUD
The following changes were made to increase readability of the Health, Shield Energy and available Abilities:

 Health is now a green bar on the left
 Shield Energy is a blue bar on the right
 Offensive abilities light up orange when ready
 Shields light up blue when ready
 Overall size of the HUD is increased

Game Mode UI

 Introduced contextual description for each of the available game modes, while hovering over the button

Vehicle Damage
Implemented several features to communicate vehicle damage

 Vehicle health is visualized on the vehicle body depending on the health amount and can be seen as subtle body deformation, grime & grunge and smoke particles
 Added collision impact sounds

AI balancing
Increased overall effectiveness of the AI vehicles in combat ability usage & driving scenarios

 AI chooses between dumbfiring projectile abilities or waiting for the homing time based on their target’s positioning.
 AI now more effectively chooses when to use on-track abilities (ex. mines, barriers or ‘tail’ type abilities)
 AI now more effectively chooses when to use AOE type abilities (ex. Sonic Boom)
 AI is now slightly more competitive during driving scenarios

Tracks
Cyber Arena/Reverse

 Split looping roads adjusted based on the new vehicle behavior
 Split looping roads exits angled better to prevent cars from crashing into a wall. 
 Bump in the road near the end of the track reduced

Pipes/Reverse

 Widened narrow road at the start of the map to allow vehicles to drive and drift through it
 Structures around the large courtyard adjusted based on new vehicle behavior, allowing for easier drifting
 Building removed from the downward slope, ramp added instead
 Pipe roads and their exits adjusted to facilitate the vehicle behavior better.
 First pipe now flows into a curved wall which players can drive along
 Removed the pipe jump and connected it with the next section of pipe
 Barriers and collision around track adjusted to allow for better flow

Twister/Reverse

 Smoothed out initial S-curve to allow for more effective drifting

Saltspine/Reverse

 Fixed minor collision issues
 Adjusted piston obstacles logic to more effectively kill vehicles beneath it
 Fixed several AI pathing issues


We would love to hear your thoughts on the new changes & improvements! Please use our Community Discord to share your feedback and suggestions.

The team is continuing to work on the next updates that will bring further track, combat improvements and much more! 

Happy racing,
The Cyber Clutch Team

notes.title: Update 0.9.2.0 - Sneak Peek upcoming combat changes
notes.notes:
Hey Clutchers,

Our team’s been burning the midnight oil, and we’ve got some juicy details about the next update, version 0.9.2.0. Check out what's coming your way soon!


Defensive vs Offensive Combat:

The Issues we aimed to resolve:

 Energy resources were tied to both shields and offensive abilities, limiting offensive combat.
 Auto-targeting for offensive abilities was instant, leaving no room for counteractions.
 Basic attacks dealt too much damage compared to special abilities, making them less used.


The changes:

 Now, your energy is exclusively for shields – no more tough choices.
 Offensive abilities run on cooldowns, so no more energy drain.
 We’ve added a lock-in time for offensive abilities, giving you a fighting chance.
 Basic attack damage is dialed down, and special abilities are ramped up – time to get flashy!

Extra Tweaks:

 Default key binds are now more intuitive: X for basic attacks and B for shields.


[previewyoutube=BWoTiF3np0k;full][/previewyoutube]

HUD Makeover

The Issues we aimed to resolve:

 Health displayed only in numbers made it hard to read during races.
 Energy meter placement was confusing, making it unclear if it indicated health or speed.
 It was difficult to tell when abilities were ready.

The changes:

 Health is now a green bar on the left – easy peasy.
 Shields are a blue bar on the right.
 Offensive abilities light up orange when they’re good to go.
 Shields light up blue when ready.
 Plus, we’ve made the HUD bigger and better.


More on the Horizon!
We’re confident these tweaks will amp up your combat experience, but we're not stopping here. More updates are cooking, so stay tuned!

Keep your engines revved and your eyes on the road – more excitement is just around the corner. Join the chat on our Discord Channel!

Catch you on the track!

The Cyber Clutch Team

notes.title: Patch 0.9.0.1 is available now
notes.notes:
🚀 Cyber Clutch Patch 0.9.0.1 Update! 🚀

Hey Clutchers,

We’re excited to bring you a minor patch update that includes some crucial fixes. 
Our team is dedicated to ensuring Cyber Clutch continues to deliver the best combat racing experience. Here are the details of what’s new:

Patch Notes:


 🎵 Fixed additional music tracks not playing in the main menu and during gameplay.
 🔫 Fixed spawnable weapons incorrectly replicating in online matches.
 🏁 Fixed Race HUD sometimes showing incorrect race data.
 🤖 Improved AI pathing to fix endless respawning issue.
 📊 Fixed total kills being incorrectly showcased in the Profile menu.
